heroDescription: A neighbourhood café and bakery in Curtorim, Goa, serving freshly baked treats, desserts, beverages and everyday favourites.
introDescription: Nestled at Carmel View in picturesque Curtorim, Village Cafe brings together the aroma of freshly roasted coffee, oven-warm bakery specialties, decadent milkshakes, and premium ice-cream delights in a relaxing, air-conditioned sanctuary.
featuredSubtitle: Hand-crafted daily favourites prepared with premium ingredients
bakerySubtitle: Crisp cookies, tea-time rusks, sponge cakes and freshly rolled savouries
ourSpaceSubtitle: A bright, welcoming ambience designed for slow sips and good company
reservationCtaSubtitle: Planning a coffee, dessert or a relaxed meal? Reserve your table with us.
